description: Explain a cron expression in plain English and list its next N run times in any time zone — catch a schedule mistake before it fires at 3 am. Supports 5-field and 6-field (seconds) cron, ranges, steps, L/W/#, and nicknames (@daily, @hourly…). Price: free. Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

count.description: How many upcoming run times to list. Range 1-50. Default 5.

expression.description: Cron expression, 5 fields (or 6 with seconds), e.g. "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5".

tz.description: IANA time zone for the next-run times. Default "UTC".

name: cron_explain
title: Cron expression explain + next runs
